title: Qt: Extend Show Packet Bytes uncompress
description:
Add more compress routines to Show Packet Bytes decode as.

Automatic detect which routine to use to avoid having a long list of
various decode as variants. Show the compress algorithm in the hint.

I found an example where the auto-detection fails, because the wrong decompression will also return:

[crash_with_keys.pcapng](/uploads/a38b1afbd6a70b62a1f343a7378db520/crash_with_keys.pcapng)

The vast majority decompress correctly as HPACK, but in packet 20, the value 497ca58e83ee3412c3569fb50938ec4153070df8567b that decompresses to a string like "text/javascript; charset=UTF-8" with HPACK gets incorrectly auto-detected as brotli.
Unfortunately it seems as though brotli, unlike some other compression formats, doesn't have magic bytes.

We might not be able to rely on auto-detecting brotli: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/issues/1238#issuecomment-529746683

https://github.com/google/brotli/issues/727

I suppose putting brotli last might be an option, if it's the only one without magic bytes, though there still could be false positives.

The idea behind this dialog is to look at unknown bytes and try various decodings, so I would like to avoid having to select 8 different uncompress alternatives. I'm fine with putting brotli last. This is not supposed to be an exact decoding, but it would also be nice to avoid false positives.

We also get false positives with base64, and this is fine because the unknown bytes may have parts which is base64.
I swapped the order, but now a compressed brotli is decompressed as hpack_huff (from test/captures/http-brotli.pcapng).

Hmm. I do certainly like the idea of auto detecting rather than having eight or more options, but unfortunately it seems like we have at least two methods that don't have magic bytes that guarantee auto detection works. The others should generally auto detect fine, though.
Maybe move HPACK to its own option?
Let's skip Brotli and HPACK for now, I'll have another look at how this can be solved.

Where should snappy validation take place?  
The bytes below crash my dev system when Decode as "Compressed" is selected.  
I haven't been able to get the crash with Version 4.7.0rc0-1765-g09be011343dd. from automated builds.  

The bytes are `Internet Protocol Version 4, Src: 192.168.50.50 (192.168.50.50), Dst: 192.168.0.1 (192.168.0.1)` of the first packet.  

[NTP_sync.pcap](/uploads/20e160f08c3b8fb14b5d9880b670a4d1/NTP_sync.pcap)

```
0000  45 00 00 3d 0a 41 00 00  80 11 7c eb c0 a8 32 32   E··=·A·· ··|···22
0010  c0 a8 00 01                                        ····
```

The [snappy format](https://github.com/google/snappy/blob/main/framing_format.txt) says the first byte should be a chunk type but in the debugger it becomes the uncompressed length = 69.  

```

```
